acceptance_criteria: Both chat and agent outbound paths use one transport-error disposition policy rather than local exception special cases.
A retryable=false error is never retried unless an explicitly versioned contract defines a distinct reconciliation action.
A definitive not-started rejection settles failed_permanent and never enters maybe_sent recovery.
A provider-call-started SendAmbiguousError is not retried and retains an explicit ambiguous disposition.
Retryable transport errors retain bounded retry behavior, structured retry hints, stable message identity where supported, and focused cross-runtime tests.
blast_radius: Agent and chat outbound delivery, all typed transports, authentication and permanent failures, ambiguous-send handling, retry duplication, durability recovery, inbound completion, user notices, and failure telemetry.

Agent OutboundQueue ignores retryable and retries every caught error except only classifying governor sheds after exhaustion. Chat runtime likewise retries every send error and distinguishes only governor sheds before recording the remainder maybe_sent. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if both outbound loops branched on structured retryability and phase before retry and durable settlement. Exact-main source has no such branch. Fault injection must still prove not-started permanent, authentication, unsupported, ambiguous provider-started, and retryable transient behavior in both runtimes.
impact: Definitive failures can trigger duplicate or pointless provider calls, exhaust retry budgets, emit misleading user notices, and enter ambiguity recovery even when the transport contract says not to retry.
